corner.$description: Corner sizes. Plain rounds its corners (shape.round) and cuts none.

shape.$description: How corner() draws a corner: the cut (a 45° chamfer) and the rounding, each a multiple of the corner size. Cards cut by card-cut instead.

round.$description: Plain: corners round to 0.6x their size

card-cut.$description: Cards only (card-corner): the top-right cut, a multiple of the card's corner size. Plain: none

xs.$description: Only for tiny things a corner cut can't fit: checkboxes, dots
